messages:
Devlin (Sales Ops): FYI customer ACME-Health sent back their renewal invoice, they say the platform fee proration is wrong and the support tier upgrade we applied at midterm isn't reflected. invoice: INV-2026-0789, attachment in drive link.
Tara (Finance): Thanks — can you paste the invoice lines here or attach? I don't have the PDF handy.
Devlin (Sales Ops): pasted the relevant portion:
```
INV-2026-0789
Line 1: Private License (annual) - $120,000
Line 2: Platform fee (annual) - $24,000
Line 3: Support Tier: Standard -> Premium (upgrade on 2026-02-10) - $0
```
Customer says line 3 should show a prorated charge ~$6,000 for the Premium upgrade from Feb to renewal date (2026-08-01).
Samir (Acct Exec): I remember we approved a midterm upgrade (deal notes: upgrade effective 2026-02-10, customer agreed to pay prorated difference). We should have generated a separate credit/charge. Did we ever create a midterm invoice?
BillingBot: Billing event created: charge_request_id=chr_8b3f, created_by=system, invoice_link=https://billing.internal/inv/2026/0789
Jess (Customer Success): Customer emailed back with the payment screenshot — they paid the renewal invoice amount as issued and are asking for a short credit or a reissued invoice showing the prorate so they can reconcile. They called it "audit-blocking".
Tara (Finance): If they already paid, standard options: 1) issue a corrective credit memo for the prorated amount, 2) reissue invoice and request difference/credit, or 3) absorb if immaterial. Need approval for > $5k adjustments.
Michael (Legal): Quick contract check: amendment signed 2026-02-05 confirms upgrade effective 2026-02-10 with customer acceptance clause. So customer owed prorate per contract. No legal blocker to issuing credit or re-invoice.
Devlin (Sales Ops): Customer insists they paid extra to enable earlier rollout and expect the billing to reflect that. They want the accounting line so their procurement can close the quarter.
Samir (Acct Exec): Can finance confirm the correct prorate calc? Rough math: Premium - Standard = $12,000 annual diff, prorated 5.5 months ~ $5,500. Want to be precise.
Tara (Finance): I'll compute exact days and post calc. Also need to know whether we charged any midterm invoice (charge_request) — if not, we likely missed raising the midterm charge.
BillingBot: charge_request_id=chr_8b3f shows status: created -> not_invoiced
Tara (Finance): Ok, looks like system created a charge_request but it never converted to an invoice. That explains why renewal invoice didn't include it.
Alex (CFO): If this is ~$5k–$6k, approve credit memo. For anything > $25k, escalate to me for sign-off. Please include a note referencing contract amendment.
Samir (Acct Exec): Customer wants the paperwork this week. I can confirm they'll accept a credit memo with reference INV-2026-0789 and a short explanation.
Devlin (Sales Ops): Perfect. Customer also asked whether we can apply the credit as a line on their next invoice to simplify reconciliation.
Tara (Finance): We'll issue a credit memo that references the original invoice and the amendment. Posting it as a negative invoice line is fine. I'll draft the credit and route for approval. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Michael (Legal): Please include the amendment ID and the signed date on the credit memo text to avoid future disputes.
Jess (Customer Success): I'll send the customer a templated confirmation: we will issue a credit memo for X and notify them when posted. They appreciate quick turnaround.
Tara (Finance): Action items: (1) I will calculate exact prorate and draft credit memo (Tara) (2) Samir to confirm customer acceptance in writing (Samir) (3) Devlin to attach the amendment and payment screenshot to the billing ticket (Devlin) (4) BillingBot / Finance to post credit once approved (BillingBot + Tara).
Devlin (Sales Ops): tagging @Alex (CFO) — thanks for the guidance.
Alex (CFO): approve if <= $25k. Please cc me on final memo. :thumbsup:
Jess (Customer Success): noted, I'll follow up with customer after we post the credit. :raised_hands:
Tara (Finance): Will update thread when credit is posted.
BillingBot: Ticket updated: billing_ticket=BT-6421, status=awaiting_approval
Devlin (Sales Ops): thanks all — closing loop once posted.
